description: This file provides helper functions for resource block (RB) and virtual resource block (VRB) conversions, as well as functions to find empty RB intervals, specifically for 3GPP LTE/NR resource scheduling. It includes functions for converting CRB to VRB intervals based on 3GPP TS38.211 specifications, and utilities for identifying contiguous free RB ranges using bitmaps.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_dl_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a VRB interval for downlink non-interleaved case, considering DCI format and search space type.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_ul_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a VRB interval for uplink non-interleaved case.

methods.name: vrb_to_crb_ul_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a VRB interval back to a CRB interval for uplink non-interleaved case.

methods.name: find_next_empty_interval
methods.description: Finds the next contiguous range of RBs with bits set to zero within specified search limits.

methods.name: find_empty_interval_of_length
methods.description: Finds a range of contiguous RBs with length up to 'nof_rbs' that are free (bits set to zero), returning the longest such range.
